title: The other half of the game
dek: Super Sprint, Gauntlet, Super Off Road, and the people beside the cabinet. An interactive arcade remembrance, signed Michael Hoydich.
author: mike
source: Mike's direct chat directive, September 29, 2026: create an arcade remembrance on PointCast, an ode to Super Sprint, Gauntlet, Super Off Road, multiplayer cabinets, trackballs, buttons and steering wheels, and their experiential quality and presence in film; signed Michael Hoydich. Codex drafted the prose and built the interaction from that directive. No specific personal memories are invented.
body:
The cabinet was only half the game. The other half was the people standing beside it.

An ode to wheels, trackballs, buttons, shared screens, and the little crowd that forms around a game. Spin the wheel, roll the ball, try four cabinet memories, and leave a place for the next player.

Michael Hoydich

media.alt: The other half of the game — an arcade remembrance by Michael Hoydich
